# Self-hosted frontend dependencies

These files are packaged in the Archive WAR so that application pages do not
execute styles or scripts fetched from a third-party origin at runtime.

## Font Awesome Free 5.15.4

- Package: `@fortawesome/fontawesome-free@5.15.4`
- Source: `https://registry.npmjs.org/@fortawesome/fontawesome-free/-/fontawesome-free-5.15.4.tgz`
- Source archive SHA-256: `6d890608585d48f50f6434a90ed3f581e76d360edb26800dba2f782ef3e77e11`
- Packaged CSS SHA-256: `99464ceb71bc9bbdcc72275faefe44f98eb5cbb6b5d8ee665b87b35376f1a96e`
- Included: `css/all.min.css`, three WOFF2 webfonts, and `LICENSE.txt`
- License: Font Awesome Free License (see the packaged `LICENSE.txt`)
